# Allen Law Accident & Injury Lawyers

> > A Gainesville-based personal injury law firm serving North Central Florida with experienced trial attorneys handling accident claims on contingency.

Allen Law is a full-service personal injury firm founded by Bill and Ginny Allen, with offices in Gainesville and Ocala. The firm specializes in representing accident victims across multiple practice areas including car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, bicycle accidents, pedestrian accidents, brain injuries, slip and fall cases, and wrongful death claims throughout Florida.
